checkRuns.command: bun add -d @types/node 2>&1 | tail -3 && bun run check 2>&1 | tail -6 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -25

kill %1 2>/dev/null; pkill -f 'dist/server/entry.mjs' python3 - <<'EOF' p='astro.config.mjs' s=open(p).read() s=s.replace(""" checkOrigin: false } """,""" checkOrigin: false }, vite: { build: { // Keep client scripts as files instead of inlining them into the HTML. assetsInlineLimit: 0 } } """) open(p,'w').write(s) p='src/pages/books/index.astro' s=open(p).read() s=s.replace(""" ""","""{' '} """) open(p,'w').write(s) EOF bun run check 2>&1 | tail -4 && bun run build 2>&1 | tail -2 PORT=4701 HOST=127.0.0.1 ORIGIN=http://localhost:4701 NODE_ENV=production bun run start > /tmp/srv.log 2>&1 & sleep 2; B=http://127.0.0.1:4701 for p in /contact /books /books/dracula; do curl -s $B$p | grep -o ']*>' ; curl -s $B$p | grep -c 'required\|Favorite\|Thanks'; done curl -s $B/books | grep -o '

kill $(cat /tmp/srv.pid) 2>/dev/null; sleep 1; ss -ltnp | grep 4701; bun remove happy-dom >/dev/null 2>&1; grep -c happy package.json; bun run check 2>&1 | tail -4; bun run build 2>&1 | tail -1; git status --short
